title: The Goats on the Island
offer: My four goats swam to Bergö! They eat Dagny's flowers, and she is cross. Bring them back before they eat her kiln too!

steps.load_say: Take them, take them! They ate my flowers and a basket and a shoe!
steps.say: My naughty goats! Tomorrow I build a higher fence. Here, my best cheese.

fact: Goats are good swimmers when they must be, and they eat nearly anything.
